propositions: doctor lock census scan_locks cannot see snapshot-GC worker-held locks because gc_trigger acquires a stamped worker lock at snapshot-store/gc/worker.lock outside the tracker-adjacent lock set

snapshot-GC worker lock shares the same v2 ownership stamp and staleness adjudication via stamped_file_lock and stamped_file_is_stale as drain and compact-worker locks, so doctor's _existence_report reader handles it unchanged
snapshot-GC lock probe path must be derived read-only without materializing the per-host snapshot store directory, distinguishing it from store_root which has mkdir/chmod side effects
added peek_store_root non-creating derivation seam and worker_lock_probe_path to gc_trigger so doctor census can probe the snapshot-gc-worker leg without creating directories
snapshot-gc-worker leg reports held-for/holder/staleness or free when store absent, and is covered by tests with autouse REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR pin to prevent host-global state leakage
